title: The jump district's trophy region writes jump.reached for the body that touches it
binding: Both legs boot a minimal host that imports modules/jump.world.json under alias 'jump' and spawns the local seat on jump_jump-arrival with the jump_vaulter kit. The positive leg flies the seat on a straight diagonal clear of every platform's solid geometry into the trophy's region and reads jump_reached, which the jumpTrophyReached rule (an Edge-mode compareState over the reserved $region:jumpTrophy occupancy read) sets to 1 the tick the region's occupancy crosses zero. The discriminating leg drives the identical heading for a third of the flight time, well short of the trophy's 1.2-unit region, and reads jump_reached again — proving the flag is written on actual contact rather than echoed unconditionally.
